en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own dates and budget and compare Playa, Cancún and Tulum with real prices
en.runTitle: Houston to the Mexican Caribbean: five days in March on about USD 2,400 for two

Arrival airport and flight times

fields.label: Budget and exclusions
fields.value: about USD 2,400 for two, excluding flights

en.template: Plan a Mexican Caribbean trip for {travellers} on {dates}, flying from {origin} to {arrival}, with {budget}. Compare Playa, Cancún and Tulum; keep daylight transport and flexible beach days. Verify current entry rules and the latest US advisory, obtain date-specific full hotel and transport prices, and separate published fees from estimates. Include one ruin and one suitable cenote without rushing. Plan only; do not book, contact anyone, create accounts or pay.

phases.title: Check current official fares, ruin fees, transport and public hotel rates
phases.note: Bus and train fares, visitor tax, ruins, cenotes, hotels, sargassum and advisories
phases.judgment: It caught that the common advice “you can’t climb Cobá” is out of date: the heritage institute’s current page lists controlled summit access. It also refused to present Cobá’s MX$210 ticket as the all-in cost, because a separate community charge is not verified.

phases.title: Build the five-day plan and a balanced budget
phases.judgment: It wrote the gaps into the plan instead of smoothing them over: no verified March hotel prices, the latest US advisory page blocked, and some early research done in a saved browser profile before being rechecked in a fresh private window.

phases.title: Write the plan and source list, then have them independently checked
phases.judgment: The reviewer recalculated all 14 budget rows (MX$43,200, or US$2,400, including a MX$5,214 contingency) and found nothing that contradicted the disclosures. It also said plainly that it had not re-checked outside sources or how the page looks.

workers: Read the official bus and train fares and timings from the airport to Playa del Carmen, and the Quintana Roo visitor tax
Compared Cobá and Chichén Itzá on official fees, hours and rules, and found cenote entry prices
Looked up central Playa del Carmen hotels and public room rates for the travel dates
Read the finished plan, recalculated the budget rows and cross-checked the claims against the source list
